        self._fetched = False
        self._finished = False

        # Stale or duplicate generation
        if generation != self.generation:
            return False
        # If failed, end busy immediately
        if status == "failed":
            self.busy = False
            self._status = status
            return False
        # For queued or running, keep busy but don't fetch yet
        if status in ("queued", "running"):
            self._status = status
            return False
        # For completed status

            if not self._fetched:
                self._status = status
                self._fetched = True
                return True
            else:

        return False

        if not self._fetched:
            return False
        # Accept rows and end busy
        self.rows = list(rows)
        self.busy = False
        self._finished = True
